create.name: Buddha-Haus
create.bio:
Buddha-Haus is a German Buddhist meditation and study association rooted in the Theravada teaching of Ayya Khema, the Berlin-born nun who returned to Germany after five decades abroad and ordained in Sri Lanka in her fifties. She and a small circle of students turned a guesthouse in the Allgäu, in the Bavarian foothills of the Alps, into a seminar house and taught the first retreat there in 1989. A publishing house, Jhana Verlag, followed to keep her books in print, then a city centre in Munich, and in 1997 the Metta Vihara, a forest monastery a short drive away and the first of its kind in Germany. A centre in Stuttgart opened in 1999.

After Ayya Khema's death in 1997 her long-time companion Nyanabodhi took on the spiritual direction; he gave up monastic robes in 2020 and teaches today as Roland Nyanabodhi, alongside a wide group of lay teachers she encouraged to teach. The Allgäu house runs a full year of silent retreats on mindfulness, insight, loving-kindness and the absorptions, as well as donation-based Wednesday meditation evenings that can also be followed online. Guests can stay at the Metta Vihara for guided or self-led retreat time. The association also supports a meditation centre and charitable work in Ladakh, and shares its teaching on YouTube and Insight Timer.

courses.title: Retreats at Buddha-Haus Allgäu: 2027 Programme
courses.description: The seminar house's year of residential courses, most held in noble silence, led by teachers in Ayya Khema's tradition. Themes for 2027 include the four foundations of mindfulness, vipassana, loving-kindness, breath meditation and an Easter retreat with Roland Nyanabodhi; booking opens on 9 November 2026 and is taught in German.
courses.price: Varies by course and room, e.g. €742–€952 EUR for 7 days with board

courses.title: Open Meditation Evening (Wednesdays)
courses.description: A two-hour evening of shared sitting and a short talk at the Allgäu house, given in turn by teachers connected with Buddha-Haus. Beginners are welcome, and most evenings can also be joined online.

courses.title: Retreat Stays at the Metta Vihara Forest Monastery
courses.description: Individual stays at the forest monastery, with three hours of group sitting a day, walking meditation in the grounds and a share in community work. At set times a visiting teacher is present for talks and personal interviews; guests stay in single rooms.
courses.price: Suggested gift €280–€720 EUR per week, depending on the kind of stay

courses.title: Winter Self-Retreat at the Metta Vihara
courses.description: A quiet winter period in which meditators who already know the monastery can practise on their own, with a minimum length of stay. It is unaccompanied by a teacher.

free_resources.title: Buddha-Haus on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations from the Buddha-Haus teachers on Insight Timer, free to play.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 7.9k followers (queue entry, read 1 Nov 2026); YouTube @BuddhaHausMettaVihara 9.68k subscribers (channel header, 5 Nov 2026); Instagram @buddhahaus not readable (off limits) → ~17.6k → local_hero
flags: Listed as an organisation (a Buddhist meditation association with a seminar house, a forest monastery and city centres), not an individual; the queue entry is the organisation's own Insight Timer channel. Owner may prefer to hold organisations until the organisations shelf rule applies.
Email: the contact page shows 'info(at)buddha-haus.de' (written with (at)); the home page carries info@buddha-haus.de in plain text. Organisation inbox.
Photos are of places, not a person: the Allgäu meditation hall and the Metta Vihara pagoda, both 600px from the home page. The YouTube avatar is a lotus drawing (logo-like) and was not used.
Base: Oy-Mittelberg, Bavaria (registered office and seminar house; a municipality of about 4,500, under the 5,000 mark). Regional: rural Allgäu, Germany.
Teaching is in German; videos and course titles are German.

The site links to Ayya Khema's books in its own shop (buddha-haus-shop.de, Jhana Verlag) but the shop was not fetched, so no books were added; the founder has died, and her books are hers rather than the organisation's.
YouTube page notes there are three Buddha-Haus channels; only the Metta Vihara channel linked from the home page was used.
left_out: Kursprogramm 2026 courses: dated and past or started by 9 Nov 2026.
Individual 2027 courses: they share one programme page with no unique URLs, so they go in as one item.
Munich and Stuttgart city centres: their programmes are on separate websites (buddhahaus-muenchen.de, buddhahaus-stuttgart.de), not fetched.
Winter retreat of the Young Buddhist Network at the Metta Vihara (Feb 2027): run and booked by another organisation.
Videos with 'Sexsucht', 'Warum Schmerz?' and 'Mit Liebe heilen' in the title: condition or healing framing.
Mahabodhi charity project in Ladakh: charitable work, not an offering.
